The separate lists give EU/UK customer coverage, 14 Stripe-account business locations (AT, BE, CH, DE, DK, ES, FI, FR, GB, IT, NL, NO, PL, SE) and EUR, CHF, GBP presentment. Customer filing deadline newly stated as 120 calendar days from the transaction; merchant evidence text changes 12 to 15 calendar days. The latter is an evidence-submission deadline, and the guide does not state its start trigger. Stripe notifies by email, Dashboard or configured webhook (`charge.dispute.created`), holds the disputed amount pending Mondu resolution, and returns it to Stripe balance if the merchant wins; otherwise the disputed amount stays with the customer. Dashboard and API evidence routes remain (old lines 222–244; new lines 234–256).

Both versions support full and partial refunds up to 180 days after purchase with asynchronous completion described as up to five minutes. Final outcome arrives via `refund.updated` or `refund.failed`; `Refund.status=succeeded` is success, and if failed the amount returns to Stripe balance and the merchant must arrange an alternate refund (old lines 246–253; new lines 258–265). New raw: `raw/stripe-payments-mondu-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw: `raw/stripe-mondu-2025.md`. Current summaries: `wiki/sources/source-stripe-mondu.md`.

- Q1: For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mondu`, what central documented behavior, prerequisites, identities and state boundaries does the complete new capture establish, and how does it compare with the matched old capture and every mapped current summary?

- Q2: Which changes are substantive versus presentational or navigation-only? Which historical claims must remain dated, which conflicts need reciprocal warnings, and which API, UI, version, client/server or outcome qualifications prevent unsupported inferences?

reviewed_answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mondu, the November 7, 2026 guide describes customer invoice payment offered by Mondu on 30-day net terms and a customer-initiated redirect to Mondu for a credit check, followed by return to the merchant (old raw lines 6-8 and new raw lines 7-9). These are the buyer’s Mondu terms. The separate May and November BNPL matrices both mark Stripe Invoicing and Stripe Subscriptions Unsupported for Mondu (May BNPL raw lines 40-48 and November BNPL raw lines 41-49). Their footnoted `setup_future_usage` support does not establish recurring payments. Both captures list EU/UK customers, 14 Stripe-account business locations, EUR/CHF/GBP presentment by country with EUR default, and Standard payout timing. The paid-upfront wording does not prove bank payout, and browser return does not prove approval or payment success (old raw lines 6-79, new raw lines 7-80, old raw lines 255-261 and new raw lines 267-273). The method lists Payment Links, Checkout and Elements, with no Express Checkout Element, no Checkout setup or subscription modes, and no recurring payments. It documents manual capture support and a maximum of 19,999.99 EUR or equivalent (new raw lines 41-51 and new raw lines 113-115). Dashboard enablement and dynamic selection remain, and November adds an email-based early access eligibility review and conditional waitlist alongside the method’s Connect Yes (old raw lines 36-38 and old raw lines 86-99, new raw lines 37-39 and new raw lines 72-111). November gives customers 120 calendar days from the transaction to dispute and merchants 15 calendar days to submit evidence. Stripe can notify through email, Dashboard, or the configured `charge.dispute.created` webhook and holds the disputed amount pending Mondu’s decision. A merchant win returns it to the Stripe balance. A customer win leaves it with the customer. Full and partial refunds up to 180 days after purchase remain asynchronous, up to five minutes, with final `Refund` state and `refund.updated` or `refund.failed` events. Failed refunds return the amount to the Stripe balance and require an alternative merchant refund (old raw lines 222-253, new raw lines 234-265). `source-stripe-mondu.md` retains May No and 12-day evidence wording and needs the dated changes and state qualifications.
reviewed_answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mondu, the substantive November changes are method-level Connect No to Yes, new eligibility screening and conditional early-access waitlist, added customer filing limit of 120 calendar days from the transaction, and merchant evidence deadline 12 to 15 calendar days (old raw lines 36-38, new raw lines 37-39 and new raw lines 82-92, old raw lines 222-244 and new raw lines 234-256). The guide does not specify a start for counting the evidence period. Keep May No and 12 days dated in `source-stripe-mondu.md`, the Stripe BNPL concept and the separate overview route. The cross-method tables already marked Connect Supported in May and do in November. November’s method Yes aligns with that capture without specifying account eligibility or charge types. Keep Mondu's 30-day buyer invoice payment terms distinct from Stripe Invoicing and Stripe Subscriptions, both marked Unsupported in the separate May and November BNPL product matrices. Keep their footnoted `setup_future_usage` signal separate from the method’s No for recurring payments. The Mobile Payment Element cell changes from Unsupported in May to Supported in November in those same cross-method matrices (May BNPL raw lines 40-48 and November BNPL raw lines 41-49). That matrix change supplies no mobile integration contract or account entitlement and is separate from the changes in the pinned method overview. New Checkout and Elements links, the quickstart path, punctuation in the 19,999.99 EUR maximum, and formatting are presentational or navigational. The prohibited bullet block is unchanged and does not establish a cross-method ranking (old raw lines 71-107 and old raw lines 109-220, new raw lines 72-119 and new raw lines 121-232). Preserve the May detailed EUR-only Checkout compatibility separately from the overview’s currency map, the optional manual PaymentIntent capture schedule as acceptance-guide evidence, and the specific distinction between instant merchant-offer language, Standard payout and actual bank availability (old raw lines 6-38 and old raw lines 255-261, new raw lines 7-39 and new raw lines 267-273).
